fixed_issue.finding: Ambient autocast could lower internal precision while a final cast made output appear FP32. Current CLI contexts were unaffected.
fixed_issue.fix: Disable autocast around native encode and decode; independent regression checks internal output types and exact output equality.

read_review.first_image_profile: Pinned original-image file hash, one RGB frame, independent 48-channel observation, no old latent/actions/future target loader; source-bound CPU checks before weights. Watchdog 900 seconds, 18 GiB process/driver cap and 2 GiB available-memory floor.
read_review.full_decode_profile: Hash-bound successful first-image evidence; observation-only safe_open; retained canonical noise and exact prefix concatenation. No denoiser or image-quality claim. Original temporal loop and optional cache allocator hook; all 17 synthetic outputs labeled.
read_review.normalization_provenance: The JSON constants are checked against exact vendor source by both CPU suites, and profiler gates bind the full JSON and implementation hashes.
read_review.readiness: No remaining concrete codec or decode-profiler blocker found. Full-shape actual-weight speed/memory and MPS output behavior remain unmeasured.

limits: Tiny FP32 CPU neural fixtures, synthetic checkpoint values and existing meta-only evidence. This does not establish actual-weight reconstruction quality, MPS parity, generated video quality or the cost of a full native clip.
